reviewed_by: Original instruction/source review plus exact annotation-only byte/line identity proof; no new runtime acceptance

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Ten bytes at the exact entry agree between BN, r2 and the probe. angr independently recovers one block and no unresolved jumps.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: mov eax,[esp+4] loads one cdecl stack word; WinMain supplies lpCmdLine at callsite 0x0048F5F4. char const* is a supported pointer interpretation for that call, not recovery of the original source type.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: There is no arithmetic or scaling. Absolute operand 0x005C8BC8 is the original 4-byte destination; candidate uses its own CommandLine symbol.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Exactly one 32-bit destination store; no dereference of the argument. Candidate natural probe verifies the compiled A3 operand equals its mapped CommandLine global.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: No callees. The sole data effect is storing the input word. Controlled fixtures seed and restore the destination; natural probe compares string and adjacent bytes separately.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Straight-line load/store/ret preserves the argument word in EAX. No null check, error branch or conversion is added.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: Only integer-word moves and ret; no floating-point instruction or conversion.

checks.name: reviewed_startup_capture_completion
checks.rationale: WinMain callsite 0x0048F5F4 supplies lpCmdLine once; only its completed native return is accepted. Typed entry/store/return checks must complete before the explicit signal. Unrelated later startup exits do not erase this scoped observation; no runtime/gameplay parity beyond this call is claimed.

checks.name: normalized_pointer_inputs
checks.rationale: The natural pointer is not compared as a process address. Both programs must receive identical complete NUL-terminated command-line bytes; return and destination must each alias their own argument exactly. Input/adjacent memory must remain unchanged. Controlled mode never dereferences arbitrary word fixtures.

checks.name: annotation_only_identity
checks.rationale: Verified annotation relocation only; fresh compiler and runtime evidence still mandatory

runtime_contract.note: One natural WinMain invocation per game is normalized by command-line bytes plus exact argument/store/EAX alias checks and unchanged input/adjacent bytes. The same probe also executes the existing eleven controlled word-copy cases before resume; no new game inputs invented. Capture completes at this native return, not full startup/gameplay.

limits: Exact declared native scope only; no later WinMain, window, rendering or gameplay acceptance.
Existing eleven controlled word cases and one natural call per side; no universal path claim.
Old runtime artifacts remain historical; this refresh does not approve the new image.
